definitions.explanation: describes the manner of crying with loud sobs or wails

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}がおいおい{泣|な}いた。
{悲|かな}しくておいおい{泣|な}いてしまった。
examples.english: I was so sad that I burst into tears.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}を{見|み}ておいおい{泣|な}いている{人|ひと}がいた。
examples.english: There was someone bawling while watching the movie.

notes:
USAGE:
おいおい is an onomatopoeic adverb describing the sound and manner of loud, uncontrolled crying. It typically accompanies the verb {泣|な}く (to cry) as おいおい{泣|な}く.

COLLOCATIONS:
- おいおい{泣|な}く - to cry loudly, to bawl
- おいおいと{泣|な}く - same as above (with quotative と)

RELATED CRYING EXPRESSIONS:
- しくしく - sobbing quietly
- わんわん - crying loudly (like a child)
- めそめそ - whimpering, sniffling
